### Persistence in the Battle
Author: Michael Youssef, Ph.D.
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/leading-the-way/leading-the-way-week-of-march-29.html
Passage: Exodus 5:22
Points:
- Moses continued delivering God's message even when Pharaoh resisted and circumstances deteriorated.
- As situations grow harder and more frustrating, believers must respond with greater faith and patience.
- Christians can stand firm in trials because the ultimate spiritual victory was already secured at the cross.
- Believers must persistently pray and refuse to surrender when battling sin or interceding for loved ones.

### Misunderstood
Author: Charles Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-november-16-2023.html
Passage: Exodus 5:22-6:1
Points:
- Moses faced deep disillusionment when obeying God resulted in increased suffering and harsh accusations from his own people.
- Doing what is right often leads to the deep pain of being misunderstood and having motives questioned.
- Heavy suffering naturally prompts believers to bring desperate questions of why and how before the Lord.
- God does not reject, shame, or criticize His children when they bring Him raw and honest complaints.
- Even when earthly oppressors seem completely in control, God remains sovereign and will act in His time.
